field_principles.corpus_path: Locates the reusable exact-labeled corpus artifact.
field_principles.corpus_ready: Only a complete leak-free corpus with passing exact controls may unlock live inference.
field_principles.corpus_sha256: Pins the reusable corpus bytes to a stable digest.
field_principles.duplicate_leakage_count: Gates readiness on no duplicate candidate leakage across partitions.
field_principles.exact_validator_backend: Names the deterministic exact validators used as authority.
field_principles.exact_validator_is_oracle: Bare boolean disclosing that labels come from an exact fixture oracle, not a learned verifier.
field_principles.family_counts: Confirms the four required families meet their row floors.
field_principles.field_principles: Keeps every headline and gate field annotated by its evidence boundary.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Provides a terminal evidence boundary without model quality or speedup claims.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic exact fixture validation with no LLM.
field_principles.invalid_rejection_rate: Positive control rate for exact rejection of invalid near misses.
field_principles.label_counts: Confirms valid and invalid classes are balanced.
field_principles.llm_invoked: Prevents the corpus from being mistaken for live model inference.
field_principles.mutation_distance_counts: Audits one-edit and two-edit invalid controls separately from valid identity rows.
field_principles.mutation_operator_counts: Audits which controlled corruptions generated the near misses.
field_principles.n_instances: Counts exact-labeled independent rows available for comparisons.
field_principles.n_rows: The exact corpus must meet the preregistered scale floor.
field_principles.partition_counts: Confirms train, dev, and test partitions are populated.
field_principles.positive_control_passed: Bare boolean requiring valid acceptance and invalid rejection controls to pass.
field_principles.source_fixture_path: Pins generation to the exact ASP/FSM fixture source.
field_principles.tests_run: Records the focused verification commands used for this artifact.
field_principles.valid_acceptance_rate: Positive control rate for exact acceptance of valid rows.
